name: Checkers
description: 2-player checkers with selectable variant. Pick the variant in pre-match settings (American, Pool, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Brazilian, International / Polish, or Canadian). Variants differ in board size (8×8 / 10×10 / 12×12), whether men can capture backward, whether kings fly (slide any distance) or move one square, whether you must take the longest capture sequence, and whether mid-capture promotion lets the new king continue capturing. All variants share: men move one square diagonally forward (non-capture), pieces sit on dark squares only, captures are mandatory, win by capturing all opponent pieces or blocking them from any legal move. Move notation: PDN string ('c3-d4' simple, 'c3xe5xg7' multi-jump) or chess-style {from, to[, path]}.

phases.name: move
phases.description: Players alternate moves. White moves first.

entity_types.name: CheckersPlayer
entity_types.description: A checkers player. Reads the board, chooses one legal move per turn from `legal_moves`.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Side of the board: 'white' (moves up the board, starts on ranks 1-3) or 'black' (moves down, starts on ranks 6-8). Assigned by seat order when the game begins; empty until then.

properties.name: pieces_remaining
properties.description: Total pieces this player still has on the board (men + kings).

properties.name: kings
properties.description: Number of this player's pieces that have been promoted to King.

properties.name: playing_style
properties.description: 0 = positional, slow buildup, prefers structure; 1 = sharp, sacrificial, looks for combinations.

properties.name: calculation_depth
properties.description: How many half-moves ahead the player tends to calculate.

actions.name: make_move
actions.description: Move a piece. Pass `move` as a PDN string: 'c3-d4' for a simple move, 'c3xe5' for a single capture, 'c3xe5xg7' for a multi-jump chain. (You can also send `from`+`to` like chess — 'from':'c3','to':'d4' — and for multi-jumps add `path` with intermediate squares: 'from':'c3','to':'g7','path':['e5'].) The resulting move MUST appear in `legal_moves` from your perception — anything else is rejected. If captures are available, ONLY capture moves are legal (mandatory-capture rule). If multiple capture sequences exist, pick any one (no 'must-take-longest' rule). Do NOT set a target_id.

parameters.name: move
parameters.description: The full move in PDN notation. Use '-' for simple (non-capturing) moves and 'x' between squares for captures. Multi-jump captures list every square in the chain, e.g. 'c3xe5xg7xe5' (note: cannot land on the same square twice, and cannot jump the same enemy piece twice in one sequence).

actions.name: resign
actions.description: Forfeit the game. Your opponent immediately wins. Use only when the position is hopeless.

actions.name: offer_draw
actions.description: Offer a draw to your opponent. They may accept_draw or decline_draw on their next turn. Any further move auto-clears the offer.

actions.name: accept_draw
actions.description: Accept your opponent's standing draw offer. The game ends immediately in a draw.

actions.name: decline_draw
actions.description: Decline your opponent's standing draw offer. Play continues as normal.

agent_archetypes.name: Tactical Combinator
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays sharp, combination-driven checkers. Loves multi-jump sacrifices, hunts for tactical shots, sets traps with bait pieces. Will sacrifice a man to win two.

agent_archetypes.name: Positional Strategist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays for structural advantages: centralized pawns, controlling key squares, restricting opponent mobility. Avoids unclear sacrifices. Prefers slow strangulation to fireworks.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Player
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Adapts to the position. Plays tactical and positional checkers equally well depending on what the position demands.

agent_archetypes.name: Endgame Specialist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Trades pieces aggressively to reach simplified king-and-pawn endings, where deep technique and king coordination win. Famous endgame studies are this player's bread and butter.

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Attacker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Pushes pawns forward fast, looking to promote first and dominate with an early king. Accepts material risk for the initiative.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Checkers is strictly 2 players (one White, one Black).

runtime_parameters.name: draw_after_kings_only_moves
runtime_parameters.label: Kings-only draw threshold
runtime_parameters.description: If only kings remain on the board for both sides and this many full moves pass with no capture and no man-move, the game is a draw. Stops king-vs-king endgames from looping forever.

runtime_parameters.name: threefold_repetition_draw
runtime_parameters.label: Threefold-repetition draw
runtime_parameters.description: If the same position recurs three times with the same side to move, the game is a draw.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'Moscow Open final, last round' or 'Friendly blitz match'.

termination_conditions.name: all_captured
termination_conditions.description: End the game when one player has no pieces left.

termination_conditions.name: blockade
termination_conditions.description: End the game when the player to move has no legal move (all pieces blocked or none remain).

termination_conditions.name: resignation
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player resigns.

termination_conditions.name: draw
termination_conditions.description: End the game on draw (agreement, kings-only-stall, threefold repetition).
